D11: every claim field is derived (catalog/version/provides from the provider catalog's identity package via the module's cue.mod dependency) or stamped (providerRef from instance context), with exact-equality provides verification at acceptance; the only authored fact is the dependency version. D12: instance-derived dot-joined CR name, so duplicates arbitrate at acceptance naming the claimant, never at SSA apply. ## Status legend

- **draft** — initial design, actively being written
- **accepted** — design agreed upon, ready for implementation
- **implemented** — design has been realized in code
- **superseded** — replaced by a newer enhancement (see `superseded_by` in the entry's config.yaml)
